description: This file defines an interface 'WebSocketAuthorizationEnforcer' responsible for enforcing authorization checks during WebSocket connection establishment, specifically validating DittoHeaders and returning a future with possibly augmented headers or throwing an exception.

classes.name: WebSocketAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: Interface for enforcing authorization in WebSocket connections, with a method to check authorization asynchronously.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the WebSocket connection is authorized based on the provided DittoHeaders, returning a CompletionStage with verified headers or throwing an exception if authorization fails.
